lane: H80-OTA orphan thermal alignment (collinear off-catalogue hot wells/springs)
hypothesis: Wells/springs with high chemical-geothermometer excess (dT = max(Tqtz,Tchalc,Tcat) - Tsurf >= 30C, max geotherm >= 90C; tier A) or measured temp >= 40C (tier B) that lie >1 km from every visible catalogue fault (orphans) are collinear along concealed, catalogue-missing geothermal conduit faults.
mechanism: GDR1391 points deduped by cell (1002 tier points in footprint: 412 A, 590 B); orphan = >10 px from reference catalogue (visible in holdout: 654 orphans; full catalogue for final map: 630). Weighted azimuth-bin collinearity votes (36 bins, neighbours 5-40 px), splatted +/-40 px along best azimuth (sigma 1.5 px across) -> ota_line; ota_x_ridge = sqrt(rank(ota_line) * max(rank(band3 tmi_hg), rank(band5 iso_grav_slope))); plus orphan/hot proximity channels. 4 OTA channels added to the shared 33-channel stack (raw+terrain+rad, features77 definitions) in an HGB; dotted emission 37,654 dots, min_sep 2.8 px, catalogue distance >2 px, 0 dots on catalogue. The label-derived CSV column dist_known_fault_px was never read.
named_non_fault_mimic: Wells drilled along roads/canals/valley axes (anthropogenic collinearity) and regional aquifer flow along basin axes.
